convertibility_reason: Martingale position sizing with margin-dependent lot calculation, custom Unity indicator (iCustom) with event-driven initialization via CHARTEVENT_CUSTOM, multi-symbol hedging support, tick-level execution for bar/tick-wise mode, heavy external .mqh dependencies for trading logic, and optimization frame management with HTML report generation

derived_values.name: lotsLimit - maximum lot after N multiplications
derived_values.formula: MathFloor((lotsLimit * factor) / lotsStep) * lotsStep, repeated limit times

derived_values.name: Unity outer indices (max and min currency buffer indices)
derived_values.formula: ArrayMaximum(data) and ArrayMinimum(data) across Unity indicator buffers

params.price_distance_formula: price - stopLoss for buy, price + stopLoss for sell
price + takeProfit for buy, price - takeProfit for sell

other_exits: Close position when outside scheduled trading hours (if UseTime enabled)
Opposite signal closes existing position before martingale re-entry in reversed direction
If previous position was profitable and no signal, re-enter same direction with initial lots
If previous position was losing and no signal, re-enter opposite direction with multiplied lots (martingale reversal)

params.margin_fallback: revert to initial lots if insufficient margin for multiplied size
params.max_lot_cap: lotsLimit calculated from initial_lots * factor^limit, capped at SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX

position_sizing.conditional_logic: After profitable trade: reset to initial lots, keep same direction. After losing trade: multiply previous lots by factor, reverse direction. If multiplied lots exceed lotsLimit: reset to initial lots.

custom_logic_notes: Multi-currency EA using Unity indicator to rank currency strength across 7 pairs. Signal is generated when one currency is at maximum and its pair's other currency is at minimum (overbought/oversold). BREAKOUT mode trades in signal direction; PULLBACK mode reverses signal. Martingale: after a loss, lot size is multiplied by Factor (default 2.0) up to Limit multiplications, then resets. Direction reverses after a loss. Multi-symbol support via WorkSymbols string parsing (name±lots*factor^limit(sl,tp)[start,stop]). Each subsystem gets unique magic number (Magic + index). Indicator initialization is asynchronous via CHARTEVENT_CUSTOM events - trading doesn't start until the Unity indicator reports all currency buffers. Optimization uses R-squared of volume-normalized balance curve as custom criterion. Generates HTML optimization reports with mini-charts per pass. Tick model guard requires OHLC M1 or better. Equity drawdown is tracked on-the-fly in tester via PositionStateWithEquity.
python_conversion_notes: The Unity indicator is custom and has no Python equivalent - it must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented. The multi-symbol architecture with async indicator initialization via custom events is MT5-specific and requires a fundamentally different approach in Python (synchronous data loading). The martingale logic with lot-step normalization and margin fallback is complex. The optimization report generation with HTML frames is MT5 tester-specific and not portable. The PULLBACK vs BREAKOUT signal inversion must be preserved. Time scheduling with wrap-around midnight handling (hourStart > hourEnd) must be reimplemented. Position state caching after close (reading POSITION_PROFIT and POSITION_VOLUME from a closed position object) is MT5-specific behavior that needs explicit trade history queries in Python. The TrailingStop class from the external library must be reimplemented. RSquaredTest for optimization criterion needs implementation. The CHARTEVENT_CUSTOM-based initialization handshake between EA and indicator must be replaced with direct indicator calculation calls.
